components.name: Central Action Board
components.notes: All seven shared action locations plus the Imperial Recognition track. Materials Yard, Potter's Wheel, Glaze & Decoration, Commission Market and Guild & Academy use 2/3/4 spaces by player count; Kiln Yard and Labour are uncapped.

components.name: Shared Kiln Board
components.notes: Seven spaces: 3 High (+1), 2 Middle (0) and 2 Low (-1); cover 1 High at 3 players and 1 High plus 1 Middle at 2 players.

components.name: Kiln Player Boards
components.notes: Ru, Guan, Ge, Ding and Jun. Each includes a Kiln Tradition, Tech area, Finished Ceramics area and an Imperial Kiln area; only 2-4 are used each game.

components.name: Shifu Workers
components.notes: One in each player colour.

components.name: Apprentice Workers
components.notes: Three per player; all begin available.

components.name: Clay
components.notes: Brown cubes or tokens.

components.name: Wood
components.notes: Sticks or tokens distinct from Clay.

components.name: Coins
components.notes: Values 1 and 5 are useful.

components.name: Vessel Cards
components.notes: Ten each: Bowl, Plate, Brush Washer, Vase and Censer. Not a hard gameplay limit; use a proxy if all ten of a Shape are in use.

components.name: Main Order Cards
components.notes: One unified public and reservable deck with a five-card display.

components.name: Starting Order Cards
components.notes: Separate Setup-only deck; each player is dealt four and keeps two.

components.name: Starting Tech Tiles
components.notes: Four copies each of Prepared Clay, White Slip, Rapid Drying and Kiln Tending.

components.name: Advanced Tech Tiles
components.notes: Five Forming, five Glazing & Decoration and five Firing Techs.

components.name: Fire Cards
components.notes: 1 at -2, 3 at -1, 4 at 0, 3 at +1 and 1 at +2.

components.name: Kiln Contribution Cards
components.notes: Three per player: Bank the Fire, Tend the Fire and Stoke the Fire.

components.name: Imperial Recognition Markers
components.notes: One in each player colour.

components.name: VP Markers / Score Pad
components.notes: Use a score track or record VP on paper.

components.name: First Player Marker
components.notes: Passes clockwise each round.

components.name: Round Marker
components.notes: Tracks rounds 1 to 5.

components.name: Imperial Priority Tokens
components.notes: One per player colour; begins on Recognition space 3 and is taken when that player reaches it, then spent before or after a worker action for one Imperial Kiln load.

components.name: Imperial Kiln Tiles
components.notes: One-space private kiln tiles; gained at 2 Imperial Recognition and placed in the owner's Imperial Kiln area.
